description: This Java class 'LogFragment' extends Android's Fragment and provides a user interface component that contains a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It is responsible for displaying log data, setting up view parameters, and managing text updates related to log output.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that hosts a LogView within a ScrollView, used to display log messages with styling and automatic scroll to bottom.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, configuring layout parameters, style, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher for the LogView to scroll to bottom after text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the internal LogView instance.
